title: Story premise ENT031: Across the Breakfast Canyon
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (miniature adventure). Hook: Breakfast is now a survival-sized map. Takeaway/theme: A familiar surface can become a new landscape at another scale.
description: A crumb-sized explorer must return a fallen sugar crystal to a bowl, but a cereal bowl’s milk-filled moat blocks the route. The explorer sails in an empty oat shell, steers with a paper splinter, and uses a spoon already spanning the rim as a final ramp.
